title: Re-measure the sources/tasks/oracle/coverage/baseline rows and write-task coverage of the method (report, do not fix)
body:
## Goal
Measurement only. Report, do not fix. The scorer-intake scope is closed (review #920 CLEAR on score_record.py sha256 2597f67b...). `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md` marks the rows sources / tasks / oracle(XML) / coverage / baseline (`docs/perpetua/evaluation.md` lines 63-68) as NOT RE-MEASURED, and the goal requires the method to cover write tasks before write implementation. Measure the current status of each of these rows, and whether the benchmark has any write (change-artifact) tasks, from repository evidence.

Write one new file `benchmark/challenges/rows-0216.md` with: `## Rows` (a table: row, status CLOSED/PARTIAL/OPEN, EV line, repository evidence as file:line), `## Write tasks` (what exists for write/change tasks in `benchmark/`, with file:line, or the statement that none exists), and `## Recommendation` (one next task that needs no LabVIEW, no owner material and no product code, with its expected gain and a verification command). Expected gain: the next shaper picks the next gap from this file without re-surveying.

No session can run LabVIEW; claim no LabVIEW behaviour, no quality and no benchmark readiness. Do not change any other file. Do not re-survey the rows already measured in next-gap-0202.md (challenges, dependency/native keys, restricted split, reader/scorer integration, whole-method review); cite them.

## Acceptance
- [ ] `benchmark/challenges/rows-0216.md` exists with the headings `## Rows`, `## Write tasks`, `## Recommendation`
- [ ] every row status cites at least one file:line that the session read itself
- [ ] no other repository file is changed
- [ ] no `__pycache__` under `benchmark/`

## Verification
python3 -c "import pathlib; t=pathlib.Path('benchmark/challenges/rows-0216.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert all(h in t.splitlines() for h in ('## Rows','## Write tasks','## Recommendation')); assert not list(pathlib.Path('benchmark').rglob('__pycache__')); print('rows-0216: OK')"

## Context
- `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md`: the gap table this task completes.
- Tool note: if the CLI says `No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session`, that is the native-tool refusal, not a broker failure; propose the same operation again as a JSON action (Policymaker #854). Grep is one literal substring, no regex; one literal pattern per call.
- Do not check changes with `git status`; the worker directory is not a git repository and the parent commits.

## Budget
- Read whole: `docs/perpetua/evaluation.md` (Polish), `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md`, `benchmark/challenges/README.md`.
- Read in ranges only: `benchmark/protocol.md` (find sections by Grep first).
- Grep `benchmark/` for literal `write`, `changed VI`, `save version`; Glob `benchmark/cases/**` for names only.
- Do not read whole large JSON files; keep command output short; write the file and the report by turn 30.
